market_hypothesis: Over six completed five-minute bars, price, open interest, top-trader position size and taker flow build in one direction. The move is treated as informed inventory accumulation only when the count of top-trader accounts does not materially diverge against the position-size signal and the move is not already an extreme late-stage chase. Continuation is expected because new directional inventory is supported by both informed position size and realized aggressive flow rather than by broad-account herding alone.

state_machine.price_direction: sign of close-to-open move across the six completed bars
state_machine.prior_atr: median true range of the prior 48 completed five-minute bars, shifted one bar

top_account_count_condition.reason: reject cases where position-size alignment is contradicted by an extreme movement in the count of top accounts

state_machine.broad_account_condition: reject only when broad account change is both aligned with price and at least +1 prior-only robust-z; this excludes broad herding without requiring the public crowd to be contrarian
state_machine.confirmation: the current completed five-minute candle closes in the price direction
state_machine.entry: market at the next one-minute open
state_machine.stop: opposite extreme of the six completed observation bars plus 0.15 prior ATR
state_machine.stop_gap_policy: worse of stop or one-minute open

robust_z.scale: 1.4826 times rolling median absolute deviation of shifted observations
robust_z.future_information: current observation is never included in its own reference distribution

quantity_rule: current NAV times 0.03 divided by per-unit expected stop loss including price distance, entry and stop costs, market impact and funding allowance
